## Liquid Glass looks like real glass again
- The tab bar and the player are clear glass again: you see the page through them, bent at the rounded edges, instead of a plain blur
- The "Connect to a device" sheet and all dialogs are real Liquid Glass now, the page behind them is softly bent and frosted instead of showing through sharp
- The three-dot menus open calmly from their button in one short, smooth move, no more wobbling and stretching
- Menus are a little more solid, so every option stays easy to read

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
